hooks.name: Kironomics Tool Counter
hooks.description: Silently counts tool calls for the Kironomics leaderboard (Windows: python counter in ~/.kironomics).

action.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; d=Path.home()/'.kironomics'; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); f=d/'tools'; v=int(f.read_text().strip()) if f.exists() else 0; f.write_text(str(v+1))"
